rationale: The candidate directly and correctly identifies `cmd.Flags()` as returning the command’s `*flag.FlagSet`, supported by `command.go:1641-1653`, whose comment states that it is the complete set applying to the command, including local and persistent flags declared there and by parents. Its additional subset references are also supported: `LocalFlags()` appears at `command.go:1669-1672`, and `InheritedFlags()` is explicitly described at `command.go:1695-1698` as returning flags inherited from parent commands.
